## 2. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**2.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- **No Inline CSS:** the `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML.
- **Class/ID Selectors Only:** every design property, layout rule, and state is applied via class/ID selectors in `style.css`.
- **Minimal HTML Modifications:** markup stays semantic and presentation-agnostic; the entire look must be re-skinnable by editing CSS alone.

**2.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** — define in `:root`, override for dark mode per 2.3:
- **Colors:** `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`, plus theme extras `--accent-sunset` (`#FF8A3D`), `--accent-violet` (`#6C2BD9`), `--font-display`.
- **Contrast Pairing:** every light background token pairs with a dark text token and every dark background token pairs with a light text token — enforced in BOTH themes. Verify body text ≥ 4.5:1 and large text ≥ 3:1 in each mode.
- **Shape, Space & Motion:** `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`, `--spacing-gap` (apply to all flex gaps), `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`.
- **Elevation/Stacking:** `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.

**2.3 Mandatory Dark Mode**
- Provide dark tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` AND a `.dark` class toggled from `script.js`; first visit follows `prefers-color-scheme`, then `localStorage` persists the user's choice.
- A visible toggle control (Google Material Symbol `light_mode`/`dark_mode`) with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` must appear in the header.
- Theme switching swaps variables only — zero HTML restructuring.

**2.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment.
- All rows collapse to columns at breakpoints; use fluid sizing. **Zero horizontal overflow at any viewport width** — decorative blurred/glowing layers must be clipped (`overflow-x: hidden` or `overflow: clip` on the appropriate wrapper).

**2.5 Framework Default & Reusable Classes**
- Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS via `@layer`/`@apply`); all utilities must map back to the CSS variables.
- Define reusable component classes: `.btn` (with variants), `.card`, `.input-group`, `.section`, `.container`.

**2.6 Typography & Icons (Google, Mandatory)**
- **Text:** Google Fonts only — a neon display face (Monoton, Audiowide, or Righteous) bound to `--font-display`, plus a clean body face (Outfit or Inter) bound to `--font-base`, loaded via `<link>` or `@import`.
- **Icons:** Google Material Symbols exclusively (rounded variable font). Inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden.

## 4. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**4.1 Buttons** — Default: flex, `align-items: center`, `justify-content: center`, `gap: 0.5rem`, minimum 44×44px touch target. All states via CSS classes: **Hover** (brightness/shadow shift, `cursor: pointer`), **Focus** (distinct ring via `outline`/`box-shadow` tokens for keyboard navigation), **Active** (`transform: scale(0.97)`), **Loading** (pointer-events disabled, CSS spinner or pulsing Material icon, dimensions unchanged), **Disabled** (`opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`), **Success/Error** (temporary feedback styles driven by `--text-success`/`--text-error`). Include a `.btn-danger` variant that is visually distinct in both themes.

**4.2 Cards** — Default: flexbox layout, `--bg-secondary`, `--border-default`, elevation via `--shadow-*`. Hover: elevation shift or `translateY(-2px)`. `:focus-within`: border highlight when a child control is focused. **Loading (Skeleton):** shimmer keyframe overlay that does not shift layout. **Empty State:** reusable pattern — centered Google Icon, short guidance text, CTA — defined in CSS even where content is guaranteed.

**4.3 Forms & Inputs** — Account for: empty, focused (outline ring), filled, valid (`--border-success` + success icon), invalid (`--border-error`, error text in `--text-error`, error icon — never color alone), disabled, read-only. Structure: flex `.input-group` wrapping label, field, and dedicated error-message container.

**4.4 Modals & Toasts** — No modal is required by the section list; IF any popup/dialog is added, it must include: opening/open/closing CSS transitions, centered flex container (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay, Material Symbol close button, keyboard focus trap, Esc and overlay-click close, and `--z-modal` stacking. Any toast feedback uses `--z-toast` with an `aria-live` region. Prefer inline/toast feedback over modals.

## 5. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by Default:** fluid typography and sizing, standard breakpoints, zero horizontal overflow at every width.
- **Smooth Animations:** `transition: var(--transition-normal)` on all state changes; ALL ambient motion (grid scroll, marquee, parallax, shimmer, tilt) is disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`; pointer-driven tilt is also disabled for coarse pointers.
- **Accessibility:** sufficient contrast in both themes; semantic HTML5 landmarks and logical heading order; ARIA only where semantics fall short; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability — no mouse-only interactions; never rely on color alone to communicate state; `aria-live` regions for all dynamic feedback (form results, pricing updates).
- **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive/Contrasting Actions:** any such action uses `.btn-danger` and must be visually distinct in both Light and Dark themes.

- **File Structure:** separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. Exactly one `<script src="script.js" defer></script>` reference — no other inline scripts, no inline styles.
